subject: Next steps: POC playbooks, updated acceptance criteria, and ownership
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novaretail.com>, NovaRetail Procurement <procurement@novaretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed playbooks and acceptance metrics (POC)

Hi Olivia — thanks for a great call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth going into the trial: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for NovaRetail search re-ranking (primary) and post-purchase chat summarization (secondary).
- Timeline: 4-week trial with a 2-week integration/run phase + 2-week evaluation window.
- Success metrics discussed: re-ranking CTR lift vs baseline, latency p95 under 300ms on queries, chat summary fidelity (ROUGE/qualitative).

What I'm sending attached:
- redwood-poc-playbooks-v1.pdf — proposed two playbooks (Search Re-rank baseline + Post-purchase summarization).
- nr-eval-matrix-2026-04.csv — draft acceptance criteria mapped to test cases and owners.

Ask / next steps (please confirm by EOD Wed Apr 14):
1) Confirm the two playbooks and prioritization (Search first, Chat second).
2) Confirm data access timeline — can our infra team get the sample query logs + anonymized purchase transcripts by Apr 20?
3) Assign a NovaRetail owner for acceptance sign-off (name & email).

Internal owners from Redwood: Rishi (integration lead), Monica (SLA & monitoring), Hannah (trial owner & success criteria).

If that aligns I will update the eval matrix with owners and a slightly tightened timeline.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-poc-playbooks-v1.pdf (5 pages), nr-eval-matrix-2026-04.csv (spreadsheet)
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novaretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, NovaRetail Procurement <procurement@novaretail.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed playbooks and acceptance metrics (POC)

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Playbooks: Confirmed. We want the Search re-ranking playbook to include a small "intent boost" test (sample queries attached in the Drive link) — that will be an important sub-case for the UX team.
- Data timeline: We can extract and anonymize the sample query logs by Apr 19, procurement will confirm by Wed. Purchase transcripts: security must review before sending; estimate by Apr 23.
- Acceptance owner: I'll be the initial sign-off contact for product acceptance (olivia.park@novaretail.com), procurement will be the contracting contact.

One additional ask: mid-trial we may want to add a third use case — "zero-result alternative suggestions" — if initial results look promising. Can we be flexible on scope if we want to add that?

I'll follow up with procurement on the data transfer and a short note on compliance (SOC2/retention).

Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Product, NovaRetail
olivia.park@novaretail.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novaretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed playbooks and acceptance metrics (POC)

Great — thanks for the confirmations and for volunteering to be the acceptance owner, Olivia. A few clarifications and an updated plan based on your note about potential mid-trial additions: 

1) "Intent boost" test: We'll add one intent-boost variant to the Search playbook (outlined in attached PDF, section 2.3). No change to timeline.

2) Data: Apr 19 for query logs is fine; Apr 23 for transcripts also fine but will be gated by your security review. Please send the security checklist items procurement requests, we can prep a compliance packet (SOC2, retention policy, encryption details).

3) Mid-trial scope change (zero-result alternatives): We can support a scope-add during the trial under the following conditions so it doesn't invalidate the evaluation: 
   - Change request submitted in writing with test definition and expected metric(s.
   - Redwood and NovaRetail agree on one of: (a) extend evaluation window by 1 week, or (b) reallocate the second week to include the new use case and reduce load on secondary test cases.
   - Any material infra/time costs > $X (TBD) will be flagged and require quick approval from procurement.

4) Updated acceptance matrix: I've made two edits to the CSV (attached): tightened latency p95 to 300ms -> 280ms for search baseline, and added a qualitative review checkpoint for chat summaries (sample of 25 summaries reviewed by product).

I'll attach the revised files once you confirm the preferences above. Proposed next milestones: 
- Apr 14: NovaRetail confirms priority & procurement timeline
- Apr 19: Redwood receives query logs
- Apr 23: Potential transcript handoff (security permitting)
- Apr 24: Redwood integration begins (Rishi)

Cc'ing Rishi and Monica so they're up to speed.

Best,
Hannah

> On Mon, 12 Apr 2026 at 09:12, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Attachments: redwood-poc-playbooks-v1.pdf (5 pages), nr-eval-matrix-2026-04.csv (spreadsheet)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: procurement redline and infra note (NR-POC-0426)

Hannah / Monica — quick internal note after reviewing Olivia's thread and procurement ping: 

- Procurement flagged a potential cost hold if NovaRetail requests the extra "zero-result alternatives" use case without extending the trial dates. They want a simple T&Cs amendment that allows small scope shifts with a mutual sign-off and capped disallowed charges. I'll draft a one-paragraph amendment to attach to the SOW.
- On infra: to hit the tightened p95 280ms we should reserve one extra inferencing slot during peak test hours; that'll be a small delta in cost but keeps SLO solid. I'll coordinate with infra and add it to the trial plan.
- I'll also prepare a short acceptance-pack (one-pager) that Olivia can forward to procurement to speed compliance review.

No blockers from my side — I'll loop infra and have the amendment ready by Thu Apr 16.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Integration Lead | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
